intro_en: You will learn to set and discuss conditions in a business negotiation: deposits, deadlines, guarantees and delivery terms. You will also use -х нөхцөлтэйгээр in Mongolian and 'provided that' and 'as long as' in English.
intro_mn: Та энэ хичээлээр худалдааны хэлэлцээрт нөхцөл тавих, урьдчилгаа, эцсийн хугацаа, баталгаа, хүргэлтийн нөхцөлийг ярихыг сурна. Мөн монгол хэлний -х нөхцөлтэйгээр бүтэц, англи хэлний 'provided that', 'as long as' хэллэгийг хэрэглэнэ.

vocab.example_mn: Бид энэ нөхцөлийг хүлээн авч байна.
Эцсийн хугацаа ирэх сарын эхээр байгаа.
vocab.example_en: The deadline is at the beginning of next month.
The goods come with a one-year guarantee.
Delivery will be made within a week.
The payment will be made by bank transfer.
The shipment was delayed because of customs.
The seller is responsible for transport costs.
If you are late, you pay a penalty.

sentences.mn: Бид урьдчилгаа төлөх нөхцөлтэйгээр гэрээ байгуулна.
sentences.en: We will sign the contract provided that we pay a deposit.
alt_mn: Бид урьдчилгаа төлөх нөхцөлтэйгээр гэрээнд гарын үсэг зурна.
alt_en: We will sign the contract on the condition that we pay a deposit.
sentences.mn_latin: Bid uridchilgaa tölökh nökhtsölteigeer geree baiguulna.

sentences.mn: Урьдчилгаа гучин хувь байх нөхцөлтэйгээр бид зөвшөөрнө.
sentences.en: We agree provided that the deposit is thirty percent.
alt_en: We agree as long as the deposit is thirty percent.
sentences.mn_latin: Uridchilgaa guchin khuvi baikh nökhtsölteigeer bid zövshöörnö.

sentences.mn: Та хүргэлтийг сарын дотор хийх нөхцөлтэйгээр бид төлбөрийг бүрэн төлнө.
sentences.en: We will pay in full provided that you make the delivery within a month.
alt_en: We will pay in full as long as you deliver within a month.
sentences.mn_latin: Ta khürgeltiig saryn dotor khiikh nökhtsölteigeer bid tölböriig büren tölnö.

sentences.en: If you keep to the deadline, you will not have to pay a penalty.
alt_en: As long as you keep to the deadline, there is no penalty.

sentences.mn: Бараанд хоёр жилийн баталгаа өгөх нөхцөлтэйгээр бид захиалга өгнө.
sentences.en: We will place the order provided that you give a two-year guarantee on the goods.
alt_en: We will place the order as long as the goods come with a two-year guarantee.
sentences.mn_latin: Baraand khoyor jiliin batalgaa ögökh nökhtsölteigeer bid zakhialga ögnö.

sentences.en: Who is responsible for the transport costs?
alt_en: Who will cover the transport costs?

sentences.mn: Хүргэлт саатвал бид гэрээг цуцлах эрхтэй.
sentences.en: If the delivery is delayed, we have the right to cancel the contract.
alt_en: We have the right to cancel the contract if the delivery is delayed.
sentences.mn_latin: Khürgelt saatval bid gereeg tsutslakh erkhtei.

sentences.mn: Төлбөрийг хүлээн авсны дараа ачаагаа илгээнэ.
sentences.en: We will send the shipment after receiving the payment.
alt_en: We will ship the goods once we have received the payment.
sentences.mn_latin: Tölböriig khüleen avsny daraa achaagaa ilgeene.

sentences.mn: Эдгээр нөхцөлийг бичгээр баталгаажуулах нөхцөлтэйгээр би зөвшөөрч байна.
sentences.en: I agree provided that these terms are confirmed in writing.
alt_en: I agree as long as these terms are confirmed in writing.
sentences.mn_latin: Edgeer nökhtsöliig bichgeer batalgaajuulakh nökhtsölteigeer bi zövshöörch baina.

sentences.mn: Үнэ өөрчлөгдөхгүй байх нөхцөлтэйгээр бид урт хугацааны гэрээ хийнэ.
sentences.en: We will make a long-term contract provided that the price does not change.
alt_en: We will make a long-term contract as long as the price stays the same.
sentences.mn_latin: Üne öörchlögdökhgüi baikh nökhtsölteigeer bid urt khugatsaany geree khiine.

sentences.mn: Төлбөрийг хоёр хувааж төлж болох уу?
sentences.en: Can we pay the amount in two installments?
alt_mn: Төлбөрийг хоёр удаа хувааж төлж болох уу?
alt_en: Is it possible to split the payment into two parts?
sentences.mn_latin: Tölböriig khoyor khuvaaj tölj bolokh uu?

sentences.mn: Чанар шаардлага хангахгүй бол бид бараагаа буцаана.
sentences.en: If the quality does not meet the requirements, we will return the goods.
alt_en: We will return the goods if the quality does not meet the requirements.
sentences.mn_latin: Chanar shaardlaga khangakhgüi bol bid baraagaa butsaana.

grammar.title_mn: Нөхцөл тавих: provided that / as long as
grammar.explain_en: In Mongolian, add -х to the verb stem (the future/participle form), then нөхцөлтэйгээр: төлөх нөхцөлтэйгээр = 'on the condition that (we) pay'. The main clause comes after it and states what you offer. This is formal and typical of contracts. In English, 'provided that' is more formal, and 'as long as' is more conversational. Both are followed by a present tense even when the meaning is future: 'as long as you deliver on time', not 'as long as you will deliver'.
grammar.explain_mn: Монгол хэлэнд үйл үгийн үндэс дээр -х (ирээдүй цагийн/үйлт нэрийн хэлбэр) нэмээд 'нөхцөлтэйгээр' гэнэ: төлөх нөхцөлтэйгээр = 'on the condition that (we) pay'. Гол өгүүлбэр араас нь орж, таны санал болгож буй зүйлийг илэрхийлнэ. Энэ бүтэц албан ёсны бөгөөд гэрээнд түгээмэл. Англи хэлэнд 'provided that' нь илүү албан ёсны, 'as long as' нь ярианы хэллэг. Хоёулангийнх нь дараа ирээдүй утгатай ч одоо цагийн хэлбэр хэрэглэнэ: 'as long as you deliver on time' ('as long as you will deliver' гэж хэлэхгүй).

examples.mn: Та цагтаа хүргэх нөхцөлтэйгээр бид захиалга өгнө.
examples.en: We will place the order provided that you deliver on time.
examples.mn_latin: Ta tsagtaa khürgekh nökhtsölteigeer bid zakhialga ögnö.

examples.mn: Төлбөр бүрэн хийгдэх нөхцөлтэйгээр ачаа гарна.
examples.en: The shipment goes out as long as the payment is made in full.
examples.mn_latin: Tölbör büren khiigdekh nökhtsölteigeer achaa garna.

examples.en: Let's lower the price provided that you give a guarantee.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Бид таны саналыг сайн судаллаа. Үнэ бидэнд тохирч байна.
dialogue.en: We have studied your offer carefully. The price suits us.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bid tany sanalyg sain sudallaa. Üne bidend tokhirch baina.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.en: Thank you. Then let's discuss the terms of the contract.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Бид гучин хувийн урьдчилгаа төлөх нөхцөлтэйгээр гарын үсэг зурна.
dialogue.en: We will sign provided that we pay a thirty percent deposit.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bid guchin khuviin uridchilgaa tölökh nökhtsölteigeer garyn üseg zurna.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.mn: Зүгээр. Гэхдээ та үлдэгдлийг ачаа гарахаас өмнө төлөх ёстой.
dialogue.en: Fine. But you must pay the balance before the shipment leaves.
dialogue.mn_latin: Zügeer. Gekhdee ta üldegdliig achaa garakhaas ömnö tölökh yostoi.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Зөвшөөрлөө, хэрвээ та хүргэлтийг сарын дотор хийх баталгаа өгвөл.
dialogue.en: Agreed, as long as you guarantee delivery within a month.
dialogue.mn_latin: Zövshöörlöö, khervee ta khürgeltiig saryn dotor khiikh batalgaa ögvöl.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.mn: Гаальд саатахгүй л бол бид амжуулна. Саатвал яах вэ?
dialogue.en: We can manage it as long as customs doesn't hold it up. What if it is delayed?
dialogue.mn_latin: Gaalid saatakhgüi l bol bid amjuulna. Saatval yaakh ve?

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Таны буруугаас саатвал өдөр бүр нэг хувийн торгууль төлнө.
dialogue.en: If it is delayed through your fault, you pay a one percent penalty per day.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tany buruugaas saatval ödör bür neg khuviin torguuli tölnö.

dialogue.speaker: Emma
dialogue.mn: Бичгээр баталгаажуулах нөхцөлтэйгээр би зөвшөөрч байна.
dialogue.en: I agree provided that it is confirmed in writing.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bichgeer batalgaajuulakh nökhtsölteigeer bi zövshöörch baina.

culture_note.en: In Mongolian business culture, relationships and trust matter a great deal, so negotiators often spend time on tea and conversation before talking about money. Conditions are usually raised politely and indirectly, but the final terms are expected to be put in a written contract. Foreign partners should be patient: a verbal agreement is a good sign, but it becomes firm only when it is signed.
culture_note.mn: Монголын бизнесийн соёлд харилцаа, итгэлцэл чухал тул хэлэлцээрийн өмнө цай ууж, ярилцахад цаг гаргадаг. Нөхцөлийг ихэвчлэн эелдгээр, шууд бусаар тавьдаг ч эцсийн нөхцөлийг бичгээр гэрээнд тусгана. Гадаадын түнш тэвчээртэй байх хэрэгтэй: амаар тохирох нь сайн дохио боловч гарын үсэг зурсны дараа л баттай болно.

review.notes: Mostly accurate and natural; one mismatched sentence subject (sentence 2) and the 'өдөр бүрд' error in the dialogue are the real mistakes, the rest are minor.

opus_fix.notes: Mostly solid. The main fixes are the mn grammar explanation not matching the en version and malformed distractor forms.

changes.why: A deadline doesn't 'end'. The new wording is more natural.
More natural wording than 'хоёр хэсэгт хуваан'.
Now says the same as explain_en. The unsupported claim about dropping 'that' is removed.
'сэн'/'даг' gave misspelled forms (хийгдэсэн, хийгдэдаг). The new distractors are valid forms on their own but wrong before нөхцөлтэйгээр.
